$comment: Houdini Atlas — Alien Spider Capstone planning pack. Cross-module composition plan. Build by hand inside a single subnet.

inputs.name: in_optional_path_curve
inputs.rationale: If wired, the spider follows this path; if absent, the spider is in rest pose at origin.

subgraph.name: controls
subgraph.rationale: Single Null exposing every variation knob from variation-matrix.csv as spare parameters. The rest of the network reads ch('../controls/...').

subgraph.name: legs

loop_strategy.stable_id_strategy: set i@leg_id = leg_index BEFORE any per-leg deletion or transform.

subgraph.rationale: One leg curve per leg, all 8 unioned with leg_id frozen so downstream filters can never scramble.

subgraph.name: carapace_surface
subgraph.rationale: Sphere → mountain → density mask → scatter. Mask combinator (vex_mask_combinator) optionally combines two recipes.

subgraph.name: instance_assignment
subgraph.rationale: Writes @instance_index per scatter point. Bounded modulo so out-of-range never reaches the renderer.

subgraph.name: merge_skeleton
subgraph.rationale: Single merge for downstream consumption. Keep separate output nulls for legs vs carapace if you need them isolated for proofs.

summary: controls → every other node via channel references

honesty: This is a planning artifact. The actual subnet must still be built by the learner. Parameter names and even node types may differ slightly across Houdini versions.
